subject.title: Feature: Expose OpenRouter usage cost to agent runtime

question: What provider-reported OpenRouter cost metadata contract should OpenClaw expose to agents, sessions, transcripts, and status surfaces?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix affects runtime/session semantics, provider-cost precedence, units, plugin/channel consumption, and user-facing cost wording, so automation should not choose the public API shape alone.

options.title: Add exact-cost metadata contract
options.body: Expose provider-reported cost as additive structured metadata with source, units, raw details, and fallback to existing local estimates when exact data is unavailable.

options.title: Keep exact cost outside core
options.body: Leave core on estimated cost fields and route exact OpenRouter accounting to a plugin or external ledger surface until a broader accounting contract exists.

options.title: Fold into broader usage ledger
options.body: Defer this issue until the native per-call usage ledger and agent-facing usage API define the shared cost metadata contract.

recommendation.title: Add exact-cost metadata contract
recommendation.body: Expose provider-reported cost as additive structured metadata with source, units, raw details, and fallback to existing local estimates when exact data is unavailable.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest history on OpenRouter cost reconciliation and the related runtime/session usage surfaces.
